note: The Bank of Maldives' schedule of charges and fees (65th edition, effective 5 October 2026), as the Maldives Monetary Authority publishes it: its Classic Visa or Mastercard credit card charges 2.85% a month on a rolled-over balance and MVR 450 a year; its issue fee isn't written. The bank's own site answered with a bot check and wasn't read.
